# MatchStamp { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp(
    coordinates=dict(),
    source_id='',
    stated_pairs=list(),
    inferred_pairs=list(),
    source=None,
    is_interpolated=False,
    conversion_maps=False,
    interval_claims=list(),
)
```

A synchronized timestamp across multiple timelines.

A MatchStamp represents a single coordinate (or instant) that has been
synchronized across multiple timelines by the anchors MatchClaims state
and/or by edges the MatchGraph inferred through group membership.

Contains one coordinate per participating timeline, each pair of
timelines linked by a stated or an inferred edge.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name            | Type                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinates     | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.Coordinate`)\] | Dictionary of timeline ID to canonical coordinate.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| stated_pairs    | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]\]                 | The (tl_a, tl_b) timeline pairs a MatchClaim's anchor links.                                                                                                                                                        |
| inferred_pairs  | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]\]                 | The (tl_a, tl_b) timeline pairs linked by no stated anchor: in a bundle's stamps, inferred through a group, a parent/child offset or a WarpMap transfer; in a MatchGraph's own stamps, its :class:`InferredEdge` s. |
| axis            | [IdCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.IdCoordinate`)                             | Identified source coordinate derived from storage.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| source          | \'AlignmentBundle \| None\'                                                      | Bundle that produced the stamp.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| source_id       | [str](`str`)                                                                     | Timeline ID used for the query.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| is_interpolated | [bool](`bool`)                                                                   | Whether the stamp used interpolated transfer.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| conversion_maps | [ConversionMapsSpec](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.ConversionMapsSpec`)            | Conversion maps available to unit lookup and display. Opt-in: defaults to ``False``.                                                                                                                                |
| interval_claims | [list](`list`)\[[MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)\]        | The interval claims covering the queried position, in relevance order: the claims themselves, never copies.                                                                                                         |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> stamp = MatchStamp(
...     coordinates={
...         "score": Coordinate(100.0, TimeUnit.quarters),
...         "audio": Coordinate(45.5, TimeUnit.seconds),
...     },
...     source_id="score",
...     stated_pairs=[("score", "audio")],
... )
>>> stamp.get_coordinate_for("audio", format="float")
45.5
```

### filter_by_timelines { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp.filter_by_timelines }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp.filter_by_timelines(within=None, id_pattern=None)
```

Create filtered stamp with subset of timelines.

The stamp's source (:attr:`source_id`, the queried timeline) is
always kept; the filter selects the others.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                 | Description                                                       | Default   |
|------------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| within     | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | Only these timelines' coordinates beside the source (None = all). | `None`    |
| id_pattern | [str](`str`) \| None                 | Regex filter for the other timelines' IDs.                        | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                             |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchStamp\' | New MatchStamp with filtered timelines. |

### get_unit { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp.get_unit }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp.get_unit(
    unit,
    *,
    timeline_id=None,
    format='id_coordinate',
    rounding='round',
)
```

Get the query coordinate converted to a unit.

Unit conversion is delegated to the source timeline's owning group so
the same conversion-map selection rules as ``TimeStamp`` apply.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                              | Description                                | Default           |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                     | The target unit.                           | _required_        |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) \| None                                              | Optional stored axis to select explicitly. | `None`            |
| format      | [CoordinateFormat](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateFormat`) | Requested coordinate output format.        | `'id_coordinate'` |
| rounding    | [Rounding](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.Rounding`)                 | Integral projection mode.                  | `'round'`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                          | Description                          |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | [CoordinateResult](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateResult`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | The converted coordinate projection. |
